methods.name: LOOK FOR YOUR NUMBERS SOMEWHERE ELSE
methods.outcome: The previous scalar path radius R_t^w was identified exactly with the return probability of a reversible two-state chain having stationary mass beta/kappa and relaxation rate w*kappa. This is classical Ehrenfest/Krawtchouk-type prior art at the scalar Markov level; the unresolved part is the sharp reversible/self-adjoint block-Jacobi degree-layer extremal.

methods.name: SWAP THE QUANTIFIERS
methods.outcome: Proved the single-reference-radius pressure theorem: bounded source LDA through D_n and log(1+chi2(q_*))=o(D_n) at one reference q_* imply bounded full chi-square for every fixed stronger noise q<q_*. If the low-degree advantage vanishes, TV tends to zero. Mao-type zero-LDA strong-distinction families necessarily have reference-pressure exponent at least log(q_*/q)>0.

methods.name: BREAK THE SYMMETRY ON PURPOSE
methods.outcome: Proved subgroup monotonicity for symmetrized likelihood-ratio degree energy: for H<=G, ||Pi_H f_j||^2 >= ||Pi_G f_j||^2. For linear codes this is the exact orbit-refinement inequality sum N_C^2/|C| >= N_O^2/|O|. Thus breaking permutation symmetry cannot remove the spectral orbit-collision obstruction and can only increase noised chi-square degreewise.
